newsitem.title: FRANCE: Michelin says responding to EU probe.
newsitem.headline: Michelin says responding to EU probe.

text.p: Europe's leading tyremaker Michelin is responding to a request for information from the European Commission, which is probing its sales practices, but has no comment on the investigation, a spokeswoman said on Thursday.
She told Reuters that Michelin had received a request for information and was replying, but she declined to say more.

An EU source said this week that the Commission was probing Michelin and notably its rebate practices to see whether they constituted an abuse of its dominant market position. The source said no formal complaint had been lodged against Michelin.
The probe is looking into whether its practices are similar to previous actions that led to a 1981 EEC judgment against Michelin's Dutch subsidiary, the source said.
The European Court of Justice in 1983 upheld the judgment but reduced the fine to 300,000 Ecu from 680,000.
The source said the current probe was looking at the French tyre market but could concern other European markets.
